title: A reader writes: Praying you won’t be harmed

body:
A reader writes:

 Thank you! You are brave and I’m so grateful for your books.  I no longer feel alone!

 Please pray for me as I consider sharing The Great Spiritual Migration with others.

 I am praying for you too. Specifically that others will not harm you with discouraging words or actions. That you will continue to inspire us to love others and that you will be blessed for doing so.

 Thanks for these words of encouragement and blessing. So many people who speak for change in the direction of reconciliation and peace are targeted for harm, so your prayers are greatly appreciated. You are in my prayers today, and I hope many readers of this blog will join me. We’re in this together!
